responsibility: Implements gm2’s compile-time evaluation engine and typed value stack, representing integers, reals, complex values, sets, arrays, records, and constructors as front-end cells carrying GCC `Tree` nodes, source locations, solved-state, and aggregate member/range lists. It performs constant folding, type coercions, set algebra and bit-range construction, aggregate/constructor assembly, overflow checks and diagnostics through `M2MetaError`, and emits or consumes GCC trees through helpers in `m2expr`, `m2type`, `m2convert`, and symbol-table services.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of M2ALU: it defines the stack cell variants, range/field/element lists, free-list management, and the GCC-tree-based evaluation and constructor-building logic that realizes the API in M2ALU.def. Unlike the .def file, it contains the concrete constant-folding engine and overflow/error handling.
